argv:
set -euo pipefail
work=${RUNNER_CHECKOUT:-/root/runner/checkout}
mkdir -p "$work"
find "$work" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name suite -exec rm -rf {} +
if [ -d "$work/suite" ]; then
  find "$work/suite" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name target -exec rm -rf {} +
fi
tar --no-same-owner -xzf "$CAIRN_LAB_MOUNT_IN_TREE_TAR_GZ" -C "$work"
cd "$work"
source cloud/pod_env.sh
JOB_DIR=$CAIRN_LAB_OUT JOB_WORKDIR=$work exec bash cloud/job_runner.sh

env.JOB_CMD: mkdir -p experiments/cairn-runpod-queue-20261006/outputs && cd suite && cargo build --release --locked --bin ca-ic --example f4_matrix_bench 2>&1 | tail -n 3 && ./target/release/ca-ic run --degree 23 --curve-a 1 --out ../experiments/cairn-runpod-queue-20261006/outputs/ic-k1-n23.json

note: Unconfined (sandbox none) on a Runpod pod, a container with no engine inside: cairn passes a GPU only to a job an engine runs, so the spec asks for none, and the job uses the pod's GPU directly.
